description:
H.W. Martin Holdings Limited

Job Title: Ledger Assistant
Department: Finance
Reporting to: Head of Finance
Location: Blackwell, Derbyshire (J28, M1)
Hours: Full-time 37.5 hours
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
Additional benefits: 25 Days Annual Leave + Public Holidays, Fully Paid Company Pension, Life Assurance, Discretionary Bonus, Employee Assistance Programme

About the H. W. Martin Group:

The Martin Group of Companies (est. 1976) provide specialist services to the construction and waste recycling industries, through a trained and certificated workforce of over 1,600 delivering works and support services from design, through to build and onward maintenance. With a turnover of more than 300m and a fleet of over 500 vehicles we are a major contributor in our fields of expertise.

Job Purpose

To provide efficient and accurate support to the Finance Department, with responsibility for the day-to-day administration of both the Sales Ledger and Purchase Ledger functions.

The successful candidate will ensure that sales invoices are raised and processed accurately, supplier invoices are recorded and paid in a timely manner, and customer and supplier accounts are maintained and reconciled. The role will also involve liaising with customers, suppliers and internal departments to ensure the smooth running of the finance function.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Ledger:

Raising and processing customer sales invoices accurately and in a timely manner.

Ensuring invoices are raised in accordance with customer contracts, purchase orders and agreed rates.

Distributing sales invoices to customers and ensuring all supporting documentation is provided where required.

Processing customer credit notes and amendments.

Monitoring customer accounts and allocating incoming payments against outstanding invoices.

Carrying out regular customer account reconciliations.

Monitoring aged debt and assisting with credit control activities.

Contacting customers regarding overdue invoices and outstanding payments.

Investigating and resolving customer invoice queries and discrepancies.

Maintaining accurate customer account details and records.

Assisting with month-end sales ledger reporting and reconciliations.

Purchase Ledger:

Receiving, checking and processing supplier invoices and credit notes onto the accounting system.

Ensuring invoices are correctly coded to the appropriate nominal ledger codes, departments and contracts.

Reconciling supplier statements and investigating any discrepancies.

Dealing with supplier queries relating to invoices, outstanding balances and payments.

Preparing and processing weekly and monthly supplier payment runs, ensuring invoices are paid in accordance with agreed payment terms.

Ensuring supplier accounts are accurate and kept up to date.

Assisting with month-end purchase ledger procedures.

Maintaining accurate electronic records and supporting documentation.

Skills and Experience

Essential:
- Previous experience working within an accounts or finance department.
- Experience of sales ledger and/or purchase ledger processing.
- Good understanding of basic accounting principles.
- Good numerical and analytical skills.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good organisational and time management skills.
- Confident communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Outlook.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Ability to manage workloads and meet deadlines.

Personal Attributes:
- Reliable, organised and proactive approach to work.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
- Professional and confident when dealing with customers and suppliers.
- Good problem-solving skills and ability to use initiative.
- Flexible approach to supporting the wider Finance Department.
- Positive attitude and willingness to learn and develop.

Next Steps

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from any suitably qualified persons.

Apply today or contact Macildowie for further information.

Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience, with benefits
Additional benefits: 25 Days Annual Leave + Public Holidays (pro rata based on days worked), Fully Paid Company Pension, Life Assurance, Discretionary Bonus, Employee Assistance Programme

About the H. W. Martin Group:

The Martin Group of Companies (est. 1976) provide specialist services to the construction and waste recycling industries, through a trained and certificated workforce of over 1,600 delivering works and support services from design, through to build and onward maintenance. With a turnover of more than 300m and a fleet of over 500 vehicles we are a major contributor in our fields of expertise.

Job Purpose

To take responsibility for the day-to-day credit control function, ensuring customer accounts are monitored effectively, and outstanding debts are collected in a timely manner.

The role will involve maintaining regular contact with customers, chasing overdue invoices, resolving payment queries and helping to minimise outstanding debt across the business.

The successful candidate will be organised, confident and proactive, with good communication and negotiation skills and the ability to manage customer relationships professionally whilst ensuring agreed payment terms are adhered to.

Key Responsibilities

Credit Control:

Monitoring customer accounts and reviewing aged debt reports on a regular basis.

Proactively contacting customers regarding outstanding and overdue invoices.

Following up on promised payment dates and ensuring commitments are met.

Sending customer statements and copies of outstanding invoices where required.

Maintaining regular communication with customers to ensure payments are received within agreed terms.

Identifying overdue and high-risk accounts and escalating concerns where necessary.

Monitoring customer accounts against agreed credit limits.

Highlighting accounts approaching or exceeding their credit limits.

Assisting with decisions regarding placing accounts on hold or restricting further services where appropriate.

Maintaining accurate records of all credit control activity and customer communications.

Supporting the business in reducing aged debt and improving cash flow.

Customer Account Management:

Building and maintaining professional relationships with customers.

Responding to customer queries regarding outstanding invoices and account balances.

Investigating payment discrepancies and unallocated cash.

Resolving invoice queries by liaising with internal departments.

Following up on disputed invoices and ensuring queries are progressed promptly.

Liaising with operational teams to obtain supporting documentation, timesheets, purchase orders and job information where required.

Ensuring customer account information and contact details are kept up to date.

Monitoring customer payment patterns and identifying any changes in payment behaviour.

Skills and Experience

Essential:
- Previous experience in a credit control or accounts receivable role.
- Confident and professional telephone manner.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong negotiation and problem-solving skills.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Outlook.
- Strong organisational and time management skills.
- Ability to manage workload independently and prioritise tasks.
- Confident dealing with customers and handling difficult payment conversations.
- Good attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to work towards targets and meet deadlines.

Personal Attributes:
- Proactive and persistent approach to debt collection.
- Confident and assertive when dealing with overdue accounts.
- Professional and diplomatic when managing customer relationships.
- Organised and methodical.
- Able to work independently and use initiative.
- Resilient and comfortable having difficult conversations.
- Strong attention to detail.
- Reliable and flexible approach to work.
